topics.description: The investigation into the fatal shooting of a Minneapolis woman by an ICE agent is ongoing, with Minnesota officials claiming they are being cut out of the investigation. The FBI has taken over the investigation, sparking concerns of a cover-up.
topics.reason: FBI takes over investigation, Minnesota officials claim they are being cut out

topics.description: The investigation into alleged daycare fraud in Minnesota is ongoing, with Governor Walz doubting the investigation will reach a fair outcome. The fraud is estimated to be over $100M.
topics.reason: Governor Walz doubts investigation will reach fair outcome
